title.en: Tale 17 — The Fur Coat in Summer

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: بعز الصيف، جحا لبس فروة تقيلة.
sentences.en: In the middle of summer, Juha wore a heavy fur coat.
They asked him: are you not hot?
He said: the fur stops the heat from getting in.
In the winter, he wore the same fur coat.
He said: and it stops the warmth from getting out.
